template_data.headline_html: Five mistakes that silently kill your GSA margins.

items.title: Wrong commercial anchor
items.sub: GSA is tied to your best commercial rate — not your public list price.

items.title: Price Reduction Clause exposure
items.sub: Discount below GSA with any commercial client and the government is owed the same rate.

items.title: Rates without documentation
items.sub: No Basis of Award on file means rejection. Every price needs a paper trail.

items.title: Labor categories too broad
items.sub: Broad categories invite audit disputes. Tight, defined categories protect you.

items.title: Prices set once, never updated
items.sub: GSA allows modifications. If costs rose and your rates didn't, you're billing at a loss.
